name: Greenway Assault
description: The Greenway supply lines are disrupted. MERIDIAN-7 is ready to formalize the Array Alliance — intel, equipment, and a full tactical briefing before the push on the Spire of Winds.

secure_alliance.label: Secure the Array Alliance
secure_alliance.description: The supply sabotage is done. Return to MERIDIAN-7 at the Array Hub and confirm the alliance. The Array's support could be decisive for the assault on the Spire of Winds.

completionActions.text: Array Alliance confirmed. MERIDIAN-7 is coordinating tactical support.

receive_intel.label: Receive Bulwark Tactical Intel
receive_intel.description: MERIDIAN-7 has compiled patrol routes and defensive data on Bulwark forces holding the Spire of Winds. Request the full briefing.

choose_equipment.label: Select Assault Equipment
choose_equipment.description: MERIDIAN-7 can provision specialized gear for the operation. Choose a package — infiltration, assault, or full kit — based on your approach.

completionActions.text: Equipped and briefed. The three-faction coalition moves on the Spire of Winds.
